requirements.general: STPM Pass with a minimum Grade C (GPA 2.0) in any two (2) subjects and a pass in Mathematics and English at SPM level or its equivalent. A-Level Pass with a minimum Grade D in any two (2) subjects and a pass in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent. UEC Pass with a minimum Grade B in five (5) subjects and a pass in Mathematics and English. STAM Pass with a minimum Grade Jayyid and a pass in Mathematics and English at SPM level or its equivalent. Foundation / Matriculation Pass with a minimum CGPA of 2.00. Diploma / Advanced Diploma (Level 4/5, MQF) or Equivalent Pass with a minimum CGPA of 2.00. Additional Notes The requirement to pass Mathematics at the SPM level can be waived if the qualification contains Mathematics with an equivalent or higher achievement. Malaysian students who have used English as the medium of instruction in their previous studies or have at least Band 2 in MUET (or equivalent) are exempt from the pass in English requirement. Candidates without a pass in Mathematics and/or English at the SPM level (or equivalent) can be admitted but are required to attend special enhancement courses, which should be SPM equivalent. English Language Requirements (for International Students) MUET: Minimum 4.0 IELTS: Minimum 5.5 TOEFL: Ess Online: Minimum 8 iBT: Minimum 46 Pearson: Minimum 51 Linguaskill: Minimum 160 OET: Minimum 200 ELS: Minimum 108 Exemptions International students with qualifications from educational systems where English is the primary medium of instruction are exempt from this requirement. Alternative Option International students who do not fulfill the English Language Requirements may join the Intensive English Programme at Nilai University, which prepares them for the IELTS examination.
